The '''Dalicron sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="Western Reaches" /> It contained the celestial bodies of [[Dalicron-4]], [[Bryndar]], [[Renforra]], [[Sappire]], and [[Vryssa]].<ref name="EAOC" />
